originality.rationale: The 2024 primary full-text Propositions 17/18/25 supply global eventual graph entry and graphwise seven-orbit behavior, but not planar Lebesgue-nullity or dimension of all preimages of the repeller. Its Section 6 describes full-plane Lebesgue measure as a further research problem. The follow-up arxiv:2503.02411, Theorem 3, explicitly confines its full-measure conclusion to the invariant graph and asks about geometry/density of planar basins. The new arithmetic lattice exclusion plus rank analysis yields the stronger planar a.e.-finite-time capture, residual basin and sharp dimension one for an uncountable parameter set. No equivalent or stronger theorem was found in checked published literature, published-finding corpus records or accessible prior research claims; risk remains for unindexed literature.

value.rationale: This is a motivated, geometrically sharp answer to the full-plane basin-measure question posed in the originating paper and its follow-up, not a graphwise restatement: full two-dimensional Lebesgue measure of finite-time seven-cycle capture, dense residual capture, and exact dimension one of the exceptional set across all irrational b<=-2 and a broad rational class. The exact dimension is forced by explicit collapsing rays and a nontrivial arithmetic rank obstruction that rules out positive-area exceptional preimages. No broader downstream theorem is required for this natural complete basin invariant; the 15-divisibility limitation is disclosed.
